exercises.instruction: Choose the best word from the brackets ( ) to fill the gap.
items: 1 The country's .................... is very strong at the moment. (finance/economy/balance)
3 The gross .................... product is at an all time high. (domestic/deficit/discount)
4 We also have a trade .................... of over £16 billion. (benefit/share/surplus)
6 The number of people out of .................... is less than 400,000. (job/employ/work)

exercises.instruction: Complete each sentence by writing in the gap a word formed from the verb given in brackets ( ).
items: 1 She is an expert in .................... management. (finance)
2 The country's gross national .................... grew by 10% last year. (produce)
3 The level of .................... is high because companies have cut jobs. (employ)
4 Higher wages will increase .................... pressure in the economy. (inflate)
5 Our .................... rate was nearly 10% last year. (grow)

exercises.instruction: Find a word related to each clue. The first letters of the answers are given.
items: 1 Dealing with very large sums of money: ............ finance
2 Value of a country's products and services: economic ............
6 Cheap to buy and to use
